chunks: The transformed creatures (al-masukh) did not remain for more than three days. These were made an example through transformation, so Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, forbade eating them.

key_terms.ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ: three days, the maximum period they remained
key_terms.مُثِّلَ: were made into an example or object lesson

ai.seo_question: Why was eating the transformed creatures (al-masukh) forbidden in hadith?
ai.summary: This report states that the transformed creatures did not survive beyond three days after their transformation. It presents their transformation as a sign and indicates that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, forbade consuming them.
